data.one_liner: A custom navigation bar widget with bubble click effects and animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar widget featuring bubble click effects, icon scaling, notification badges, titles, blur effects, and floating bar options.
use_when: You want a custom bottom navigation bar with bubble animations inspired by Dribbble designs.
You need features like floating navigation bars, blur backgrounds, and notification badges on tabs.
avoid_when: You require the exact native Material or Cupertino navigation bar implementation without custom bubble animations.
You are using a routing package that heavily couples with specific navigation bars (though it can work alongside standard state management).
strengths: Cute and smooth bubble click effect animations out of the box.
Highly customizable (colors, scale factor, stroke, blur effect, floating style, border radius).
Supports notification badges and tab titles.
weaknesses: Niche UI widget with very specific aesthetic style that might not fit every app design.
Breaking changes introduced in past versions regarding widget types for icons.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. It is recommended to set extendBody to true in Scaffold when using isFloating: true.
